name: Google Workspace
since_note: Launched as Google Apps for Your Domain in 2006 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Gmail with your own domain, simple setup
notes: Priced Business Starter: $8.40 per user on the flexible (monthly) plan, $7 on an annual plan. 30 GB pooled storage. Gemini app included; advanced Gemini features not on Starter.

name: Microsoft 365
best_for: Businesses that live in Word and Excel
notes: Priced Business Basic: $7 yearly, $8.40 monthly per user (web apps only). Business Standard with Copilot is $23.50 yearly / $28.20 monthly. Basic gets only limited Copilot Chat; full Copilot is an add-on. 1 TB OneDrive and API/storage details not verified on the page text; marked from product knowledge.

name: Zoho Workplace
free_plan_limits: Workplace has none; the separate Zoho Mail free plan allows 5 users, 5 GB each
best_for: Cheapest full office suite for tiny teams
notes: Standard $4 monthly or $3 yearly; Professional $7 monthly or $6 yearly, per user. Standard has 30 GB mail and 10 GB shared WorkDrive; Professional 100 GB each. Free Zoho Mail is a separate product and may not be offered in every region.

name: Proton
free_plan_limits: Business plans have none (Proton has a separate free personal plan)
since_note: Proton Mail went live as a public beta on 16 May 2014 (Wikipedia; CERN).
best_for: Private email and storage for a small team
notes: Mail Essentials $6.99 per user billed annually: 15 GB and 3 custom domains. Workspace Standard $12.99 per user has 1 TB; Premium $19.99 has 3 TB. Monthly prices not stated. Search results were inconsistent in age; check live page.
